1 """Conversation -> commission: the steward actually RUNS a skill (2026-08-06).
2 
3 WHY THIS MODULE EXISTS. Every seam already existed and none of them were
4 joined: the chamber could talk (converse), the engine could propose and
5 hash-confirm a commission (commission-run-bridge), a managed session could be
6 launched with the skill loaded (commission_executor.launch_commission_in_session),
7 the run loop could drive it to a decision point (commission_runner), and the
8 engine could read a finished run back to John and raise the High Seat
9 (steward-run-ingest via the same bridge). This module is the join, and ONLY
10 the join:
11 
12     propose -> John confirms -> session starts -> run loop drives -> stopped
13     -> the run record is written -> the bridge ingests it (report + raise
14     + handback) -> John opens THAT session, answers, hands it back
15     -> watch re-arms -> produced -> ingested -> reported.
16 
17 THE LONG-LIVED-PROCESS LAW (learned the hard way): a throwaway process kills
18 the PTY it starts. Launch + drive must live in ONE long-lived process — this
19 module runs inside the Anchor service, and the watcher is a daemon thread of
20 that service.
21 
22 WHAT IT NEVER DOES: answer a question the skill asked (commission_runner's
23 law), or derive project state (the engine's ledger owns that; run records
24 here are the steward's own bookkeeping about runs, nothing more).
25 
26 Stdlib only. The Node bridge is an external CLI through an injectable seam
27 (``ANCHOR_ECGBERHT_BRIDGE_CMD``), fully stubbed in tests — same pattern as
28 ``ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD``.
29 """

87 def _ecgberht_root() -> Path:
88     """ECGBERHT_ROOT env override, else the sibling checkout beside Anchor."""
89     env = os.environ.get("ECGBERHT_ROOT", "").strip()
90     if env:
91         return Path(env)
92     return ANCHOR_DIR.parent / "Ecgberht"
93 
94 
95 def run_bridge(mode: str, payload: dict, timeout: int = BRIDGE_TIMEOUT_S) -> dict:
96     """Spawn the commission-run bridge with ``payload`` on STDIN (never argv —
97     transcripts cross the 32,767-char argv cap instantly) and parse its
98     one-line JSON reply.
99 
100     ``ANCHOR_ECGBERHT_BRIDGE_CMD`` overrides the command for tests (a python
101     stub), exactly like ``ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD`` stubs the model runner.
102     """
103     override = os.environ.get("ANCHOR_ECGBERHT_BRIDGE_CMD", "").strip()
104     if override:
105         # posix=False so Windows backslash paths survive (job_runner's carried
106         # fix) — but then quoted tokens KEEP their quotes, and subprocess would
107         # double-quote them. Strip one layer of surrounding quotes per token.
108         cmd = [t[1:-1] if len(t) > 1 and t[0] == t[-1] == '"' else t
109                for t in shlex.split(override, posix=(os.name != "nt"))] + [mode]
110         cwd = str(ANCHOR_DIR)
111     else:
112         bridge = _ecgberht_root() / "scripts" / "commission-run-bridge.mjs"
113         if not bridge.exists():
114             return {"ok": False, "error": "ecgberht_engine_missing",
115                     "message": "commission-run bridge not found (set ECGBERHT_ROOT "
116                                "or keep the Ecgberht checkout beside Anchor)"}
117         cmd = ["node", str(bridge), mode]
118         cwd = str(_ecgberht_root())
119     try:
120         res = subprocess.run(
121             cmd,
122             input=json.dumps(payload),
123             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout,
124             encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
125             cwd=cwd, creationflags=getattr(_paths, "NO_WINDOW", 0))
126     except Exception as exc:
127         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_spawn_failed", "message": str(exc)}
128     out = (res.stdout or "").strip()
129     if not out:
130         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_no_output",
131                 "message": (res.stderr or "").strip()[:500]}
132     try:
133         return json.loads(out.splitlines()[-1])
134     except Exception:
135         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_bad_json", "message": out[:500]}

140 def _run_record_path(folder: str, session_id: str) -> Path:

145 def _atomic_write_json(target: Path, obj: dict) -> None:
146     target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
147     tmp = target.with_suffix(".tmp")
148     tmp.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
149     os.replace(tmp, target)

162 def list_runs(folder: str) -> list:
163     """SAFE projections of the project's commission runs, newest-first.
164     Never a worktree path, never the transcript body."""
165     root = Path(folder) / RUN_RECORDS_REL
166     if not root.exists():
167         return []
168     rows = []
169     for p in sorted(root.glob("*.json")):
170         try:
171             rec = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
172         except Exception:
173             continue
174         rows.append({
175             "session_id": rec.get("session_id"),
176             "commission_id": rec.get("commission_id"),
177             "skill": rec.get("skill"),
178             "step_id": rec.get("step_id"),
179             "lane": rec.get("lane"),
180             "outcome": rec.get("outcome"),
181             "ran": rec.get("ran"),
182             "elapsed_s": rec.get("elapsed_s"),
183             "at": rec.get("at"),
184             "watch_count": rec.get("watch_count", 1),
185             "report": rec.get("report"),
186             "prior_reports": rec.get("prior_reports") or [],
187             "reflection": rec.get("reflection"),
188             "auto_continue": rec.get("auto_continue"),
189             "auto_chain": rec.get("auto_chain"),
190             "raised": rec.get("raised"),
191         })
192     rows.sort(key=lambda r: r.get("at") or "", reverse=True)
193     return rows

208 def _claim_watcher(session_id: str, thread: threading.Thread) -> bool:

236 def confirm_and_launch(
237     folder: str,
238     proposal: dict,
239     *,
240     project_id: str,
241     who: str = "john",
242     backend: str = "claude",
243     directive: Optional[str] = None,
244     record_extra: Optional[dict] = None,
245     watch: bool = True,
246     start_session_fn: Optional[Callable] = None,
247     read_fn: Optional[Callable] = None,
248     write_fn: Optional[Callable] = None,
249     runner_kwargs: Optional[dict] = None,
250     auth_ctx: Optional[dict] = None,
251     expected_token: Optional[str] = None,
252     enforce_auth: bool = False,
253     thread_factory: Optional[Callable] = None,
254 ) -> dict:
255     """John said go: hash-confirm through the engine, launch the managed
256     session with the skill loaded and the brief seeded, and start the watcher
257     that will fetch him when the skill needs him.
258 
259     Injectable seams (``start_session_fn`` / ``read_fn`` / ``write_fn`` /
260     ``thread_factory``) make this fully testable without a live PTY.
261     """
262     if not proposal or not isinstance(proposal, dict):
263         return {"ok": False, "error": "proposal_required"}
264 
265     # W4 commission-time manifest lint (steward-chamber plan, F2): a NEW
266     # scaffold (born under the manifest convention) without a valid sidecar
267     # manifest is a HARD refusal before anything is confirmed or launched;
268     # a campaign predating the manifest routes to the W5 brownfield dual
269     # path (route "brownfield-w5") and proceeds.
270     import chamber_manifest as _cm
271     manifest_lint = _cm.commission_time_lint(folder)
272     if not manifest_lint.get("ok"):
273         return {"ok": False, "error": manifest_lint.get("error"),
274                 "message": manifest_lint.get("message"),
275                 "manifest_lint": manifest_lint}
276 
277     # W10 E2 enqueue gate (steward-chamber, C5 — ENGINE-ENFORCED on THIS
278     # seam, the W2-proven leg b): while the campaign carries a death whose
279     # containment-checked sweep card is not yet BOUND into the decision-gate
280     # queue, a re-commission is REFUSED with the named finding — before the
281     # engine confirm, before any spend. The guard fails CLOSED on an
282     # unreadable gate store (a safety gate never guesses).
283     import chamber_gates as _cgates
284     e2 = _cgates.enqueue_guard(folder)
285     if not e2.get("ok"):
286         return {"ok": False, "error": e2.get("error"),
287                 "finding": e2.get("finding"),
288                 "message": e2.get("message"),
289                 "blocking_deaths": e2.get("blocking_deaths")}
290 
291     confirmed = run_bridge("confirm", {
292         "project": str(folder),
293         "proposal": proposal,
294         "who": who,
295     })
296     if not confirmed.get("ok"):
297         return {"ok": False, "error": confirmed.get("error", "confirm_failed"),
298                 "message": confirmed.get("message"), "confirm": confirmed}
299 
300     job = confirmed.get("job") or {}
301     skill = job.get("skill") or proposal.get("skill")
302     step_id = job.get("step_id") or proposal.get("step_id")
303     commission_id = (job.get("commission_id") or job.get("job_id")
304                      or proposal.get("proposal_id"))
305 
306     # Lane resolution. researchPrime/Crucible/Foreman have dedicated lanes whose
307     # seeds load them. Gandalf and Jumper have NO lane — but a `general` session
308     # sends its seed_context ALONE as the opening turn, so the brief itself can
309     # load the skill by name (they are registered globally). Found in hardening
310     # 2026-08-06: John's step 1 IS a Gandalf read; without this his first Go
311     # refused. Truly unknown skills still refuse by name.
312     lane = _ce.lane_for_commissioned_skill(skill)
313     load_preamble = None
314     if not lane and str(skill).lower() in ("gandalf", "jumper"):
315         lane = "general"
316         load_preamble = (
317             f"Load the {skill} skill now. Confirm it's ready by greeting me "
318             f"EXACTLY once with: \"{skill} loaded — what would you like to do?\" "
319             "Then stop and wait for my next message.\n\n")
320     if not lane:
321         return {"ok": False, "error": "skill_has_no_session_lane",
322                 "message": f"'{skill}' has no managed-session lane — it cannot "
323                            "run as a commissioned session yet.",
324                 "skill": skill, "confirm": confirmed}
325 
326     # (2026-08-07) THE DIRECTIVE. The steward composes the brief from what the
327     # campaign has learned (the reflection), John iterates and approves it, and
328     # it rides here as the heart of the session's opening context — the "glue"
329     # between runs he asked for.
330     directive_block = ""
331     if directive and str(directive).strip():
332         directive_block = (
333             "COMMISSION DIRECTIVE (composed by the steward from the campaign's "
334             "current state; approved by John):\n" + str(directive).strip() + "\n\n")
335     brief = (load_preamble or "") + directive_block + build_brief(proposal, skill=skill)
336 
337     # (steward-chamber W11, E6) Standing-preferences PRELOAD: the feedback
338     # ledger + global standing rules fold DETERMINISTICALLY into the talk
339     # instruction at session start, and the projection listing EXACTLY the

341     # (chamber_preload.preload_into_instruction; verify_preload is the
342     # mechanical diff — a missing entry is a diffable failure).
343     try:
344         import chamber_preload as _cpl
345         brief = _cpl.preload_into_instruction(folder, brief)["instruction"]
346     except Exception:
347         # A preload hiccup never strands a launch; the projection sidecar's
348         # absence is itself the honest record that nothing was loaded.
349         pass
350 
351     def _launch(**kwargs):
352         return _ce.launch_commission_in_session(
353             start_session_fn=start_session_fn, **kwargs)
354 
355     store_root = Path(folder) / COMMISSION_STORE_REL
356     commission = {
357         "confirmed": True,
358         "commission_id": commission_id,
359         "skill": skill,
360         "depth": proposal.get("depth_cell"),
361         "step_id": step_id,
362         "who": who,
363     }
364     launched = _ce.execute_confirmed_commission(
365         commission,
366         store_root=store_root,
367         launch_fn=_launch,
368         lane=lane,
369         backend=backend,
370         project_id=project_id,
371         folder_path=folder,
372         prompt=brief,
373         auth_ctx=auth_ctx,
374         expected_token=expected_token,
375         enforce_auth=enforce_auth,
376     )
377     if not launched.get("ok", True) and launched.get("error"):
378         return {"ok": False, "error": launched.get("error"),
379                 "message": launched.get("message") or launched.get("user_text"),
380                 "launch": launched}
381 
382     session_id = launched.get("session_id") or launched.get("job_id")
383     if not session_id:
384         return {"ok": False, "error": "no_session_id", "launch": launched}
385 
386     record = {
387         "schema": RUN_RECORD_SCHEMA,
388         "session_id": session_id,
389         "commission_id": commission_id,
390         "skill": skill,
391         "step_id": step_id,
392         "lane": lane,
393         "project_id": project_id,
394         "outcome": "running",
395         "at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
396         "watch_count": 0,
397         "worktree_path": launched.get("worktree_path"),
398         # The composed brief rides the record so the pulse tile can show WHAT
399         # this run was aimed at (2026-08-07, John's inspect-naturally ask).
400         "directive": (str(directive).strip() if directive else None),
401         # e.g. the autonomy chain depth — merged BEFORE the watcher starts so
402         # the watcher's in-memory record carries it to its own finish_run
403         # (a post-launch disk patch would be silently dropped at run end).
404         **(record_extra or {}),
405     }
406     _atomic_write_json(_run_record_path(folder, session_id), record)
407 
408     # W4 chamber sidecar: the commission_start event-time projection, plus the
409     # manifest hash keyed to the commission id from the run record's EXISTING
410     # receipt fields (route "manifest" only). Best-effort — a sidecar hiccup
411     # never blocks a launch John just confirmed; the projections are
412     # rebuildable derived data (W5 cold-open rebuild).
413     try:
414         import chamber_projections as _cproj
415         _cproj.record_commission_start(
416             folder, commission_id, session_id=session_id,
417             step_id=step_id, skill=skill, lane=lane)
418         if manifest_lint.get("route") == _cm.ROUTE_MANIFEST:

420     except Exception:
421         pass
422 
423     watching = False
424     if watch:
425         watching = _start_watcher(
426             folder, project_id, record, watch_only=False,
427             read_fn=read_fn, write_fn=write_fn,
428             runner_kwargs=runner_kwargs, thread_factory=thread_factory)
429 
430     return {
431         "ok": True,
432         "session_id": session_id,
433         "commission_id": commission_id,
434         "skill": skill,
435         "step_id": step_id,
436         "lane": lane,
437         "watching": watching,
438         "say": (f"Commissioned — {skill} is running in a session I manage. "

443 def build_brief(proposal: dict, skill: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
444     """The opening brief, folded onto the lane seed. Everything the engine
445     proposal already knows about the step — nothing invented here."""
446     step = proposal.get("step") or {}
447     lines = [
448         f"COMMISSION BRIEF — {skill or proposal.get('skill') or 'skill'} "
449         f"for roadmap step '{step.get('name') or proposal.get('step_id') or ''}'.",
450     ]
451     if step.get("done_when"):
452         lines.append(f"The step is done when: {step['done_when']}")
453     commission = proposal.get("commission") or {}
454     if commission.get("active_effort"):
455         lines.append(f"Active effort: {commission['active_effort']}")
456     lines.append(
457         "Work from the project in this folder. When you genuinely need John's "
458         "decision, ask it plainly and stop — do not guess on his behalf.")
459     return "\n".join(lines)

462 # ── The watcher (runs inside the service — the long-lived process) ──────────
463 
464 def _start_watcher(folder, project_id, record, *, watch_only,
465                    read_fn=None, write_fn=None, runner_kwargs=None,
466                    thread_factory=None) -> bool:
467     session_id = record["session_id"]
468 
469     def _run():
470         _watch_session(folder, project_id, record,
471                        watch_only=watch_only,
472                        read_fn=read_fn, write_fn=write_fn,
473                        runner_kwargs=runner_kwargs)
474 
475     factory = thread_factory or (lambda fn: threading.Thread(
476         target=fn, name=f"commission-watch-{session_id}", daemon=True))
477     thread = factory(_run)
478     if not _claim_watcher(session_id, thread):
479         return False
480     thread.start()
481     return True
482 
483 
484 def _watch_session(folder, project_id, record, *, watch_only,
485                    read_fn=None, write_fn=None, runner_kwargs=None) -> dict:
486     """One watch: drive (or resume watching) the session, then bring the run
487     home through the bridge. Runs on the watcher thread."""
488     session_id = record["session_id"]
489     if read_fn is None or write_fn is None:
490         import terminal_session as _ts
491         read_fn = read_fn or _ts.read_since
492         write_fn = write_fn or _ts.input
493 
494     kwargs = dict(DEFAULT_RUNNER_KWARGS) if runner_kwargs is None else dict(runner_kwargs)
495     try:
496         result = _cr.run_commissioned_session(
497             session_id,
498             WORK_TURN,
499             read_fn=read_fn,
500             write_fn=write_fn,
501             watch_only=watch_only,
502             **kwargs,
503         )
504     except Exception as exc:
505         # (2026-08-07 shark round) A runner exception used to kill the daemon
506         # thread SILENTLY — the record stranded "running" forever and John was
507         # never fetched. A dead watcher is a died run: report it honestly.
508         result = {"outcome": "died", "ran": None, "elapsed_s": None,
509                   "transcript": "", "transcript_chars": 0,
510                   "watcher_error": str(exc)[:300]}
511     return finish_run(folder, project_id, record, result,
512                       read_fn=read_fn, write_fn=write_fn,
513                       runner_kwargs=runner_kwargs)

539     runs in an ISOLATED WORKTREE, so at PRODUCED time its artifacts live at

545     so the capture-first step already copies them; a missed copy is completed
546     here so the register never mints a dead Where), then registered via
547     ``effort_dir_for`` + ``where_for(abs_path=<the MAIN path>)`` with the SAME
548     what-string Hook A uses ('Gandalf read <tier> — <verdict>', verdict from
549     the exec summary's first content line when known). No worktree → nothing
550     registers (never fabricate). Never raises."""
551     try:
552         wt = str(record.get("worktree_path") or "")
553         if not wt:
554             try:
555                 import session_registry as _sreg
556                 srec = _sreg.get_session(str(record.get("session_id") or ""))
557                 wt = str((srec or {}).get("worktree_path") or "")
558             except Exception:
559                 wt = ""
560         base = Path(wt) / "gandalf" if wt else None
561         if base is None or not base.is_dir():
562             return
563         docs = []
564         for rep in sorted(base.rglob("report.md")):
565             try:
566                 if rep.stat().st_size <= 0:
567                     continue
568             except OSError:
569                 continue
570             docs.append(rep)
571             exec_md = rep.parent / "exec-summary.md"
572             if exec_md.is_file():
573                 docs.append(exec_md)
574         if not docs:
575             return
576         verdict = ""
577         for doc in docs:
578             if doc.name != "exec-summary.md":
579                 continue
580             try:
581                 for line in doc.read_text(
582                         encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
583                     s = line.strip()
584                     if s and not s.startswith("#"):
585                         verdict = s[:200]
586                         break
587             except OSError:
588                 pass
589             break
590         what = "Gandalf read %s — %s" % (record.get("tier") or "",
591                                          verdict or "complete")
592         for doc in docs:
593             rel = doc.relative_to(wt).as_posix()
594             main = Path(pfolder) / rel
595             if not main.is_file():
596                 # Persist into MAIN before registering (the git-scoped capture
597                 # normally already did; this closes the stubbed/unmanaged gap).
598                 try:
599                     import shutil
600                     main.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
601                     shutil.copy2(str(doc), str(main))
602                 except OSError:
603                     continue
604             where = _dreg.where_for(effort_dir, pfolder, project_id,
605                                     abs_path=str(main))
606             out = _dreg.register(effort_dir, what, where,
607                                  step=record.get("step_id"),
608                                  project_folder=pfolder)
609             _jnl.emit_safe(
610                 project_id, _jnl.EV_DELIVERABLE_PINNED,
611                 correlation_id=str(record.get("session_id") or ""),
612                 folder_path=pfolder,
613                 payload={"register": out.get("reason") or "unknown",
614                          "what": what, "where": where})
615     except Exception:
616         pass
617 
618 
619 def _register_run_docs(folder, project_id, record) -> None:
620     """Hook C (reports-links 2026-09-05 W2): a commissioned run that came home
621     PRODUCED (the plan's RUN_DONE) registers its HUMAN-FACING docs in the
622     effort's DELIVERABLES.md — one row per resolved role, what =
623     '<skill> — <role>: <filename>', step hint = the commission record's step.
624     Idempotent on resume (the registrar dedups on (what, where)); every
625     outcome is journaled as ``{register: written|dup|<reason>}`` on the
626     existing deliverable-pinned event. Best-effort: never raises up a
627     finishing run; a run with no resolvable docs registers nothing (an honest
628     register lists only real artifacts).
629 
630     W2 amendment (2026-09-05): at finish time the produced docs are NOT yet
631     persisted (PRODUCED is a transcript classify; capture runs on kill/close),
632     so the docs are CAPTURED FIRST (``terminal_session.capture_session_docs``)
633     and only then role-resolved — against the record's managed session id when
634     the lane grouping knows it, else against the session whose captured
635     members carry that managed id (the v8 keystone tag). A Gandalf commission
636     (lane ``general``) takes the direct-scan branch instead — see
637     :func:`_register_gandalf_read`."""
638     try:
639         import deliverables_register as _dreg
640         import effort_history as _eh
641         import journal as _jnl
642         import summarizer as _summ
643         lane = record.get("lane") or ""
644         session_id = record.get("session_id") or ""
645         skill = record.get("skill") or "skill"
646         pfolder = str(folder)
647         try:
648             import rnd_registry as _rnd
649             proj = _rnd.get_project(project_id)
650             pfolder = (proj or {}).get("folder_path") or pfolder
651         except Exception:
652             pass
653         effort_dir = _dreg.effort_dir_for(str(folder), pfolder)
654         # Amendment: persist the worktree's produced docs NOW so the role
655         # resolution below sees files that exist (list_efforts is empty until
656         # persist, and finish_run does not otherwise persist). Best-effort +
657         # idempotent; a non-managed session id no-ops inside the capture.
658         try:
659             import terminal_session as _ts
660             _ts.capture_session_docs(session_id, project_id=project_id)
661         except Exception:
662             pass
663         if str(skill).strip().lower() == "gandalf":
664             _register_gandalf_read(_dreg, _jnl, effort_dir, pfolder,
665                                    project_id, record)
666             return
667         roles = _summ.session_doc_roles(project_id, lane, session_id,
668                                         folder_path=pfolder) or {}
669         store_lane = _eh._resolve_subdir(lane)
670         if not roles:
671             # The record's id is the MANAGED session id; the capture above
672             # recorded the docs as discovered efforts grouped by their dir
673             # (a computed ``dir::…`` session id). Bridge via the v8 keystone
674             # tag: the session whose members carry this managed id.
675             try:
676                 import sessions as _sess
677                 for s in _sess.list_sessions(pfolder, project_id, store_lane):
678                     if any((m.get("session_id") or "") == session_id
679                            for m in (s.get("member_files") or [])):
680                         roles = _summ.session_doc_roles(
681                             project_id, lane, s["session_id"],
682                             folder_path=pfolder) or {}
683                         break
684             except Exception:
685                 pass
686         for role in HUMAN_FACING_DOC_ROLES.get(store_lane, ()):
687             doc = roles.get(role)
688             if not doc or not doc.get("href"):
689                 continue
690             what = "%s — %s: %s" % (skill, role, doc.get("label") or role)
691             # The Where cell is minted by the ONE resolver (where_for), fed
692             # the doc's raw facts — never the summarizer's UI href, whose
693             # spelling differs (premortem 1: a second Where form defeats the
694             # registrar's (what, where) dedup across hooks).
695             rel = (doc.get("rel") or "").strip()
696             jid = (doc.get("job_id") or "").strip()
697             where = _dreg.where_for(
698                 effort_dir, pfolder, project_id,
699                 abs_path=(os.path.join(pfolder, rel) if rel else None),
700                 lane=(store_lane if jid and not rel else None),
701                 job_id=(jid if not rel else None))
702             out = _dreg.register(effort_dir, what, where,
703                                  step=record.get("step_id"),
704                                  project_folder=pfolder)
705             _jnl.emit_safe(
706                 project_id, _jnl.EV_DELIVERABLE_PINNED,
707                 correlation_id=str(session_id), folder_path=pfolder,
708                 payload={"register": out.get("reason") or "unknown",
709                          "what": what, "where": where})
710     except Exception:
711         pass
712

714 def finish_run(folder, project_id, record, result, *,
715                read_fn=None, write_fn=None, runner_kwargs=None) -> dict:
716     """The run stopped: persist the record, then hand it to the engine —
717     report, conversation log, raise, handback — via the ingest bridge.
718     If the reflection says the next move needs no human input, CARRY ON:
719     launch it unasked (John's standing autonomy rule), capped by AUTO_CHAIN_CAP."""
720     session_id = record["session_id"]
721     transcript = result.get("transcript", "") or ""
722     # A re-armed watch must never ERASE the first watch's read (found live
723     # 2026-08-06: watch 2 saw only post-snap silence and its thin report
724     # replaced the rich verdict). Every prior report is kept.
725     prior_reports = list(record.get("prior_reports") or [])
726     if isinstance(record.get("report"), dict) and record["report"].get("say"):
727         prior_reports.append(record["report"])
728     updated = {
729         **record,
730         "prior_reports": prior_reports,
731         "outcome": result.get("outcome"),
732         "ran": result.get("ran"),
733         "elapsed_s": result.get("elapsed_s"),
734         "transcript_chars": result.get("transcript_chars"),
735         "transcript_tail": transcript[-TRANSCRIPT_TAIL_CHARS:],
736         "watch_count": int(record.get("watch_count", 0)) + 1,
737         "at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
738     }
739 
740     # (steward-chamber W11, E3) THE RESURRECTION GUARD on the W2-proven
741     # handback seam: BEFORE the ingest bridge reaches Ecgberht
742     # engine/handback-ingest.mjs :: ingestHandback /
743     # ingestValidatedHandbackBody, every predicate-bearing correction is
744     # re-asserted against the artifact it names. A regression BLOCKS the
745     # handback with the named finding; the unassertable remainder rides the
746     # report DEMOTED. Fails CLOSED on an unreadable corrections store; a
747     # project with zero corrections passes trivially (honest zero report).
748     try:
749         import chamber_corrections as _ccx
750         guard = _ccx.handback_guard(folder)
751     except Exception as exc:
752         guard = {"ok": False, "blocked": True,
753                  "finding": "E3-CORRECTION-REGRESSED-HANDBACK-BLOCKED",
754                  "error": "guard-crashed", "message": str(exc)[:200]}
755     if guard.get("blocked"):
756         updated["handback_blocked"] = guard
757         updated["ingest_error"] = guard.get("finding")
758         updated["report"] = {
759             "say": "Handback BLOCKED (%s): %s"
760                    % (guard.get("finding"),
761                       guard.get("message") or "correction regression"),
762         }
763         _atomic_write_json(_run_record_path(folder, session_id), updated)
764         return {"ok": False, "record": updated, "blocked": guard,
765                 "ingest": None}
766 
767     ingest = run_bridge("ingest-run", {
768         "project": str(folder),
769         "project_id": project_id,
770         "run": {
771             "outcome": result.get("outcome"),
772             "transcript": transcript,
773             "ran": result.get("ran"),
774             "elapsed_s": result.get("elapsed_s"),
775             "skill": record.get("skill"),
776             "step_id": record.get("step_id"),
777             "session_id": session_id,
778             "commission_id": record.get("commission_id"),
779             "worktree": record.get("worktree_path"),
780         },
781     }, timeout=INGEST_TIMEOUT_S)
782 
783     if ingest.get("ok"):
784         updated["report"] = ingest.get("report")
785         # (2026-08-07) The frontier reflection: impact, findings fed into the
786         # scaffolding, and the composed next-move directive John iterates on.
787         updated["reflection"] = ingest.get("reflection")
788         updated["raised"] = ingest.get("raised")
789         updated["handback"] = (ingest.get("handback") or {}).get("ingested") \
790             if isinstance(ingest.get("handback"), dict) else None
791     else:
792         # The ingest failing is a fact John gets, not a silent swallow.
793         updated["report"] = {
794             "say": "The run stopped but I could not read it back "
795                    f"({ingest.get('error', 'bridge_failed')}). Open the session to see it.",
796         }
797         updated["ingest_error"] = ingest.get("error")
798 
799     if result.get("watcher_error"):
800         updated["watcher_error"] = result.get("watcher_error")
801 
802     # BANK the terminal state FIRST (2026-08-07 shark round): the auto hop
803     # spawns bridge processes and can block for seconds — during which the
804     # rest of the system must already see this run as finished, not running.
805     _atomic_write_json(_run_record_path(folder, session_id), updated)
806 
807     # CARRY ON (2026-08-07): reflection said the next move is fully determined
808     # by what is on file — no decision is John's — so launch it now. Only after
809     # a clean produced run (asked/died/timeout always come back to him), and
810     # never more than AUTO_CHAIN_CAP hops without him touching the campaign.
811     updated["auto_continue"] = _maybe_auto_continue(
812         folder, project_id, updated, ingest,
813         read_fn=read_fn, write_fn=write_fn, runner_kwargs=runner_kwargs)
814     if updated["auto_continue"] is not None:
815         _atomic_write_json(_run_record_path(folder, session_id), updated)
816 
817     # W5 brief precompute (steward chamber): the reflection just landed, so
818     # precompute the situation brief into the chamber sidecar NOW — the next
819     # Seal open paints it with zero model calls (E8: steward-plane sidecar
820     # only; roadmap/receipts/reflection stores untouched). Best-effort by
821     # contract — a projector hiccup never blocks a run finishing; the W5
822     # cold-open rebuild is the cure. Runs BEFORE the campaign commit so the
823     # sidecar rides the same bank.
824     try:
825         import chamber_reconcile as _chamber_reconcile
826         _chamber_reconcile.on_reflection_landing(folder)
827     except Exception:
828         pass
829 
830     # W9 deliverable landing (steward chamber, C2 — ENGINE-FED, never
831     # model-remembered): the run just stopped, so if the manifest-declared
832     # output now exists CONTAINED on disk, record the W4 deliverable_landing
833     # projection NOW — the open chamber's injection-clock poll flips the ◇
834     # box live with no reopen. Idempotent per output path; best-effort by
835     # the same contract as the brief precompute above (a sidecar hiccup
836     # never blocks a run finishing).
837     try:
838         import chamber_deliverable as _chamber_deliverable
839         _chamber_deliverable.record_landing_if_present(folder, updated)
840     except Exception:
841         pass
842 
843     # W10 died→sweep-card state machine (steward-chamber, C5/E2): a run that
844     # ended died/quiet/timeout registers SWEEP-PENDING now — from here the
845     # E2 gate in confirm_and_launch blocks any re-commission until the
846     # containment-checked sweep card is bound into the queue, and a HELD
847     # gate is never dropped (the transition never touches the queue head).
848     # Best-effort by the same sidecar contract as the hooks above; the E2
849     # refusal itself is enforced at the confirm_and_launch seam.
850     try:
851         if result.get("outcome") in ("died", "quiet", "timeout"):
852             import chamber_gates as _cgates
853             _cgates.on_run_death(folder, updated)
854     except Exception:
855         pass
856 
857     # Hook C (reports-links 2026-09-05 W2): a run that came home PRODUCED
858     # registers its human-facing docs (idempotent on the re-armed watch's
859     # second finish); asked/died/quiet/timeout runs never register. Runs
860     # BEFORE the campaign commit so the register row rides the same bank.
861     if result.get("outcome") == _cr.RUN_PRODUCED:
862         _register_run_docs(folder, project_id, updated)
863 
864     # A finished run changed campaign state (record, attention, log) — bank it.
865     commit_campaign_state(
866         folder, f"{record.get('skill', 'skill')} run {result.get('outcome')}")
867     return {"ok": True, "record": updated, "ingest": ingest}
868 
869 
870 def _maybe_auto_continue(folder, project_id, updated, ingest, *,
871                          read_fn=None, write_fn=None,
872                          runner_kwargs=None) -> Optional[dict]:
873     """The autonomy hop: propose + confirm + launch the reflection's next move
874     when it declared needs_human false. Returns the note stored on the run
875     record (None when the situation simply doesn't call for one). Best-effort —
876     a failed hop is a recorded fact, never an exception up the watcher."""
877     try:
878         reflection = ingest.get("reflection") if ingest.get("ok") else None
879         nxt = (reflection or {}).get("next") if isinstance(reflection, dict) else None
880         if not (isinstance(nxt, dict) and nxt.get("skill") and nxt.get("directive")):
881             return None
882         if nxt.get("needs_human") is not False:
883             return None
884         # Defense in depth (2026-08-07 shark round): an unattended hop must
885         # aim a NAMED roadmap step with one of the five commissionable
886         # engines — the engine parse enforces both, this refuses if anything
887         # slipped through a stale bridge.
888         if nxt.get("skill") not in ("researchPrime", "Crucible", "Foreman",
889                                     "Gandalf", "Jumper"):
890             return {"launched": False, "reason": "skill-not-commissionable",
891                     "detail": str(nxt.get("skill"))[:60]}
892         if not nxt.get("step_id"):
893             return {"launched": False, "reason": "no-step-id",
894                     "say": "The next move named no roadmap step — bringing "
895                            "it to John instead."}
896         # A stuck model re-proposing the move that JUST ran is the classic
897         # burn loop (shark P1) — an identical hop always goes back to John.
898         if (nxt.get("step_id") == updated.get("step_id")
899                 and nxt.get("skill") == updated.get("skill")):
900             return {"launched": False, "reason": "same-move",
901                     "say": "The next move would repeat the run that just "
902                            "finished — checking with you instead of looping."}
903         if updated.get("outcome") != "produced":
904             return {"launched": False, "reason": "outcome-not-produced",
905                     "say": "The next move was ready but this run didn't end "
906                            "clean — bringing it to John instead."}
907         chain = int(updated.get("auto_chain") or 0)
908         if chain >= AUTO_CHAIN_CAP:
909             return {"launched": False, "reason": "auto-chain-cap",
910                     "say": f"I've carried on {chain} times in a row without "
911                            "you — checking in before the next move."}
912         # The finished session's PTY is usually STILL OPEN, and the executor's
913         # DEGRADED one-run-at-a-time scan refuses a new launch while a prior
914         # intent's pid is alive (found in the 2026-08-07 hardening pass —
915         # without this every auto hop dies EXEC_SUBSTRATE_BUSY). The run is
916         # produced + ingested + reflected: park it gracefully (close is
917         # warm-resumable, docs persisted; John reopens it any time).
918         try:
919             import terminal_session as _ts
920             _ts.close_session(updated.get("session_id"),
921                               project_id=project_id, actor="steward-auto-continue")
922         except Exception:
923             pass
924         proposed = propose(folder, step_id=(nxt.get("step_id") or None),
925                            skill=nxt.get("skill"))
926         if not proposed.get("ok"):
927             detail = proposed.get("error") or proposed.get("message")
928             return {"launched": False, "reason": "propose-refused",
929                     "detail": detail,
930                     "say": "I tried to carry on but couldn't frame the next "
931                            f"commission ({detail}) — your call from here."}
932         tok = _paths.expected_token()
933         launched = confirm_and_launch(
934             folder, proposed,
935             project_id=project_id,
936             # Honest provenance: John's 2026-08-07 standing autonomy rule is
937             # the confirming authority, never a fabricated human click.
938             who="john-standing-autonomy",
939             directive=nxt.get("directive"),
940             # Chain depth rides the record FROM BIRTH — the watcher's
941             # in-memory copy must carry it or its finish_run would drop it
942             # (cap bypass, found in the 2026-08-07 hardening pass).
943             record_extra={"auto_chain": chain + 1,
944                           "auto_from": updated.get("session_id")},
945             read_fn=read_fn, write_fn=write_fn, runner_kwargs=runner_kwargs,
946             auth_ctx={"token": tok} if tok else None,
947             expected_token=tok,
948             enforce_auth=bool(tok),
949         )
950         if not launched.get("ok"):
951             detail = launched.get("error") or launched.get("message")
952             return {"launched": False, "reason": "launch-refused",
953                     "detail": detail,
954                     "say": "I tried to carry on but the launch was refused "
955                            f"({detail}) — nothing is running; your call."}
956         new_sid = launched.get("session_id")
957         return {"launched": True, "session_id": new_sid,
958                 "skill": launched.get("skill"), "step_id": launched.get("step_id"),
959                 "auto_chain": chain + 1,
960                 "say": f"Carried on without you: {launched.get('skill')} is now "
961                        "running with the directive I composed — "
962                        + (nxt.get("why") or "it needed no decision of yours.")}
963     except Exception as exc:
964         return {"launched": False, "reason": "auto-continue-threw",
965                 "detail": str(exc)[:200]}
966 
967 
968 # ── Campaign state → git (a crash costs nothing) ────────────────────────────
969 
970 #: The campaign's durable surfaces — staged EXPLICITLY, never `git add -A`
971 #: (the user's unrelated changes are not the steward's to commit).
972 CAMPAIGN_STATE_PATHS = (
973     "roadmap.json", "ECGBERHT.md", "Anchor.md", "strip.json",
974     ".ecgberht", ".anchor",
975 )
976 
977 
978 def commit_campaign_state(folder, label: str = "campaign state") -> dict:
979     """Commit the steward's campaign surfaces in the PROJECT repo. Best-effort,
980     never raises — John's standing rule (2026-08-06, his first real campaigns):
981     'you should be committing things as we go along so they don't lose
982     anything.' Both his campaigns sat untracked for a day before this existed.
983     """
984     out = {"ok": False, "committed": False, "reason": "ok"}
985     try:
986         import subprocess as _sp
987         import project_bootstrap as _pb
988         folder = str(folder)
989         _pb.ensure_git_repo(folder)
990 
991         def _git(*args):
992             return _sp.run(["git", *args], cwd=folder, capture_output=True,
993                            text=True, timeout=60,
994                            creationflags=getattr(_paths, "NO_WINDOW", 0))
995 
996         present = [p for p in CAMPAIGN_STATE_PATHS
997                    if (Path(folder) / p).exists()]
998         if not present:
999             out.update(ok=True, reason="no-campaign-state")
1000             return out
1001         import git_safety as _gs
1002         with _gs.repo_lock(_gs.toplevel(folder) or folder, wait_s=60, who="campaign state " + folder) as held:
1003             if not held:
1004                 out.update(ok=False, reason="lock-busy")      # a land holds the lock; nothing committed (Grok code R1 F8)
1005                 return out
1006             _git("add", "--", *present)
1007             staged = _git("diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "--", *present)
1008             if not (staged.stdout or "").strip():
1009                 out.update(ok=True, reason="nothing-new")
1010                 return out
1011             # only these paths: never the whole index, which may hold another session's staging (Grok R2 G1)
1012             done = _git("-c", "user.email=ecgberht@anchor.local",
1013                         "-c", "user.name=Ecgberht Steward",
1014                         "commit", "-m", f"ecgberht: {label}", "--", *present)
1015         out.update(ok=done.returncode == 0, committed=done.returncode == 0,
1016                    reason="ok" if done.returncode == 0
1017                    else (done.stderr or done.stdout or "commit-failed")[:200])
1018         return out
1019     except Exception as exc:
1020         out["reason"] = str(exc)[:200]
1021         return out
1022

1024 # ── Hand it back (after John answered in the session) ───────────────────────
1025 
1026 def rearm_watch(folder, project_id, session_id, *,
1027                 read_fn=None, write_fn=None, runner_kwargs=None,
1028                 thread_factory=None) -> dict:
1029     """John answered in the session and handed it back — resume the watch
1030     WITHOUT sending anything (the cursor snaps past the old question first)."""
1031     record = load_run_record(folder, session_id)
1032     if record is None:
1033         return {"ok": False, "error": "unknown_run",
1034                 "message": "No commission run record for that session."}
1035     if watcher_active(session_id):
1036         return {"ok": True, "already_watching": True, "session_id": session_id}
1037     started = _start_watcher(
1038         folder, project_id, record, watch_only=True,
1039         read_fn=read_fn, write_fn=write_fn,
1040         runner_kwargs=runner_kwargs, thread_factory=thread_factory)
1041     return {"ok": started, "session_id": session_id, "watching": started,
1042             "say": "Watching again — carry on; I'll take it from here."}
